name: plateau
description: Bounded, predictable context for long Claude Code sessions — carry a small, re-grounded signal across steps instead of letting the transcript climb toward the context ceiling. A fact enters the carried signal only if it passes the gate (a Measurement that re-verifies against the repo now), so bounded context can't fill with stale or fabricated claims. While enabled, a SessionStart hook also loads the parent-agent delegation discipline as standing context, so long-horizon sessions automatically operate as a bounded parent that delegates to background orchestrators. New in 0.3.0: the receipt-graph bridge hooks — PostToolUse `receipt`, PreCompact `snapshot`, SessionStart `inject`, Stop `lift` (decided-fact lifting) and `handoff` (a pasteable handoff block), and SessionEnd/SubagentStop `handoff --write` + `ledger` — that record tool-call receipts into a small on-disk graph and inject a budget-bounded, query-aware slice of it back into the session, with a session-handoff block written for resume and for subagent-to-parent handback. New in 0.4: the continuum -- `because` arrows lifted from the assistant's stated reasons, and at each compaction the knowledge the current request descends from is carried in (`◉`).
